exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: GOES-19 weather eye slipping into safe hold above the hemisphere
fifteen years spent refining one product until it feels finished
a single audited feed stitching US, EU, and global AI regulation
clear midsummer morning in San Francisco, wind at fifteen

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap on stutter-house beat drops as a loop builds from silence; each clean hit adds a layer until the drop lands.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Sixty seconds to stack a satisfying drop from nothing.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and ghost notes appear between real beats.

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag repair paths through a drifting weather satellite's failing systems before it slips into safe hold.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Forty-five seconds to reconnect three sensors and feel orbit stabilize.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: More systems fail at once and paths cannot cross.

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sort incoming regulation clauses into the correct jurisdiction bins as they flood in from three continents.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Clearing a tray of ten clauses feels like untangling a knot.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Clauses arrive faster and share nearly identical wording.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick sailboats through Karl the Fog gaps between Golden Gate towers before the marine layer swallows the bay.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Each clean gap-crossing is a tiny postcard moment.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Fog rolls in faster and gaps shrink between towers.
